activity.notes: Sigismund Augustus began exercising rule in the Grand Duchy of Lithuania in 1544. ATLAS records the separate Lithuanian grand-ducal phase through the Union of Lublin on 1 July 1569, after which the existing Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth Activity represents his union-level rule.

sources.title: Important dates — Palace of the Grand Dukes of Lithuania
sources.citation_text: The National Museum–Palace of the Grand Dukes of Lithuania identifies Sigismund Augustus as Grand Duke of Lithuania from 1544 to 1572 and King of Poland from 1548.
